tickets.title: Coordinate Divorce Planning Documents
tickets.text: Use this workflow to request, organize, and route divorce-related planning documents for Nadia Pebblefizz. Keep communications neutral and factual, confirm authorization before sharing information with outside professionals, and separate advisory planning needs from legal advice. The planning packet should cover draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement-account order questions, and current statements, to be coordinated with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern after Nadia provides written authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm document scope and permissions
subTasks.text: Identify which documents are needed for Nadia Pebblefizz's separation planning, such as draft or final settlement terms, asset schedules, support obligations, retirement account orders, tax returns, and current statements. Confirm Nadia's written permission before coordinating with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern.

subTasks.title: Create secure collection folder
subTasks.text: Set up a secure upload location for Nadia Pebblefizz's separation planning documents, list missing items (joint return, property tax bill, Teacup Comet Bank mortgage payoff), and label received documents by category. Do not request or store unnecessary sensitive documents beyond the planning scope.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning summary for advisor review
subTasks.text: Summarize Nadia Pebblefizz's available assets (~$910,000 marital residence, $74,000 at Paper Otter Bank, $286,000 Velvet Acorn Custody IRA, ~$412,000 Clockwork Clover Systems employer plan), liabilities ($384,000 Teacup Comet Bank mortgage), income obligations, beneficiary concerns (Rowan Pebblefizz still listed on IRA), account titling issues, and open questions for the advisor. Flag any urgent implementation constraints without providing legal conclusions.
